items.previewSummary: Spain’s data protection agency said on Wednesday (November 11) that it had opened an investigation into the alleged spread of child sexual abuse material on TikTok. According to a Reuters report, the watchdog rejected the government’s request to temporarily block the app nationwide and said that it would consider measures targeting individual posts and links.

items.summary: Bangladesh says legal process complete to secure Hasina's return, decision rests with India: Reports The Economic Times
items.previewTitle: Bangladesh says legal process complete to secure Hasina's return, decision rests with India: Reports
items.previewSummary: Bangladesh's Law Minister Md Asaduzzaman confirmed that all legal procedures for Sheikh Hasina's extradition have been completed. Hasina, who fled to India after her government was toppled, was sentenced to death in absentia for crimes against humanity. The Indian government has acknowledged the requests but has not made a decision on her extradition. Hasina announced her intention to return to Bangladesh in December through an audio-only virtual press conference.

items.previewSummary: South Africa have announced their Playing XI for the opening Test against Bangladesh, bringing back Zubayr Hamza and Dane Paterson as they look to build on their impressive recent performances in the longest format. items.previewSummary: The promise of the digital revolution and Artificial Intelligence was simple: algorithms would take over repetitive tasks, while people would work less and have more time for creativity. In reality, more and more organizations and employees are discovering a perverse effect. The faster we become thanks to technology, the more tasks we receive, entering a vicious cycle that experts call the “efficiency trap.”A few decades ago, the emergence of personal computers and the internet was supposed to reduce the workweek. items.previewSummary: JOHANNESBURG — Temba Bavuma can move ahead of former Australia captain Lindsay Hassett’s winning start when South Africa face Bangladesh at the Wanderers on Sunday.
